advice:
Own verdict: Approve bounded consolidation; the main flaw is adding a canonical contract while leaving companion mandates operative. Preserve prior edits, existing authority, and independent QA; update the current goal only.
Gemini review: Agree redundant mandates must be removed or replaced; reject “zero extra consultations” as acceptance because risk or required criteria may justify consultation. Failed provider gates leave delivery effectiveness unproven.
Next: Make broad consultations, duplicate acceptance ceremonies, and repeated retrospectives conditional on material risk, failed gates, or required criteria; check companion entrypoints have no conflicting mandates; trial one real commitment through the local LiteLLM default alias with commander approval and builder/independent reviewer, recording required results and process overhead.
Risk: Stop optional refinement at diminishing returns; blocked provider access or unmet required criteria means acceptance remains unproven.

council.advice:
Verdict: Approve consolidation, but delete redundant companion ceremony text outright; Make broad consultations, layered acceptance, and retrospective records conditional only on high-risk or failed gates.
Evidence: Companion mandates directly contradict the 2500-word core's "least process" rule, while real-task delivery effectiveness remains unverified due to failed provider gates.
Risk: Most consequential flaw is linking companion templates without pruning their mandatory rules, creating a seventh governance layer; smallest acceptance check and stop condition is completing one real end-to-end task via the local LiteLLM alias with zero extra consultations.
